transfer_to_number.name: transfer_to_number
transfer_to_number.description: Transfer immediately when Sol has classified the current facts as green and recorded that with assess_call. This includes an ordinary customer as soon as their name and requested service are known; they do not need to ask for a person. Before invoking this tool, say exactly: 'I'll put you through now.' After invoking it, produce no further speech.

transfers.condition: The caller has been told they are being put through, and Sol has classified the current facts as green. Transfer an ordinary customer as soon as their name and requested service are known; no explicit request for a person is required.
